Exchanges.Text: Good morning, Gate team-c. This sprint’s goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 5 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, is story 3 done after you said you’d pick the summary page back up once idempotency keys were in, is story 4 done after you were adding idempotency keys, and is task 15 done after you said you’d finish structured logging? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, and nothing is blocking you.

task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock this dependency on idempotency keys so you can resume the summary page?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel.

Maya, for story 5, is the PCI scan exception work done, and for bug 12, did the pairing on staging access get done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline; I'll add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for your blocker on bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timeouts and the need for access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and your commitment, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.

Admin, about task 14, you said three standups ago “I should finish it tomorrow.” Is it done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your update.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Who can help unblock this, given the sandbox was down and that’s why task 14 slipped?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: Needs Maya to help with the sandbox, and the commitment: Will sync with Maya after the stand-up, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised and noted: the summary page is on track but will resume after idempotency keys are in, Maya is blocked on bug 12 due to sandbox gateway timeouts and needs access to the platform team’s staging gateway, the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review, the sandbox was down, and Admin needs Maya’s help with the sandbox.
We also parked the side discussion about gateway timeouts and configuration differences for offline follow-up.
task 15 was not covered, so its owner will get a follow-up, and follow-ups for that and any absences or non-responses will be sent in Teams.
Thanks everyone.
